task: Create a file named hello.txt containing the word success

commands_run.command:
cat << 'EOF' > /tmp/patch.diff
--- /dev/null
+++ b/hello.txt
@@
+success
EOF
patch -p0 < /tmp/patch.diff
cat hello.txt

critique_events.reason: The diff only modifies status.json and does not actually create a file named hello.txt containing the word "success". The patch command referenced in the diff fails (exit_code 128), so the required file is not produced.
